thread:
Elena: quick follow-up from the all-hands — we need explicit guardrails for shipping API/Console/Optimize over the next two waves. Can leadership confirm: which features are GA vs beta for Q3, how long canaries should run, and expected migration/deprecation windows? trying to lock docs and release-notes. thanks :wave:

Priya: high level — aim for API GA in the early Q3 wave, Console will be a limited GA (soft launch) late Q3, Optimize features (model caching + smart batching) stay in beta with a targeted GA in Q4. no forced cutovers. :sparkles:

Marco: to add — for Dedicated customers we need a longer canary by default because of infra variance. propose: hosted API canary 48–72h, dedicated/enterprise 7–14d. thoughts?

Jon: infra constraints — kernel selection + perf regressions are our main risk. current tests show we need ~5–7 days of traffic for stable perf signals on 90th pctl. so Marco's numbers look right. also: small ops note:
```
# example rollout command for canary
redwood rollout create --service=api --version=v2.1 --canary=10% --duration=72h
```

Aisha: on migration windows — product ops recommends a 6-month opt-in period for Console UX changes, with explicit deprecation notices at 3 months and endpoint-level redirects at 6 months. that gives PMs time to coordinate customers.

Priya: agree with Aisha. no silent removals. we'll publish a migration guide and a one‑pager for CSMs this week. action: @Elena can you own the doc and tag the CSM and Dedicated teams? :memo:

Elena: can do. I'll draft a migration FAQ and include the default canary recommendations. will ping for review.

Chris: SDK break note — if we change request/response shapes for Console v2, we should follow semver-major and provide a compatibility shim for 3 months. prefer explicit opt-in flags.

Priya: yes on semver-major. compatibility shims for public SDKs where possible. no hard breaks without a deprecation cycle.

Marco: one more ask — should we gate Optimize GA on a target cost-per-token improvement threshold? ops and finance want a measurable goal to avoid shipping if unit economics regress.

Priya: good call. set a KPI: 15–20% unit cost reduction at 95% of production workloads before GA. that will be in the release criteria doc.

Jon: I'll add telemetry hooks to validate cost/latency regressions during canary.

deploy-bot: Reminder: follow-up doc created -> https://redwood.internal/docs/release-guardrails (private) :link:

Elena: thanks all — i'll share the draft in #all-hands and ping for quick reviews.~~
